items.title: Terry Clark — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: We had Charlie Williams on alto [saxophone]

ctx.x: The Big B-A-D Band. Oh, I didn’t write anything for the Big B-A-D Band. I’m talking about the combo, I wrote. No, I wasn’t too much into big-band writing. In the big band, Ernie Wilkins, who wrote for us. He played tenor [saxophone]. We had Charles Davis on baritone [saxophone]. We had Charlie Williams on alto [saxophone], Chris Woods.
